categories.main_business_segments: Horizon Fixture Group Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of commercial display racks made from various materials and intelligent electric bed components. The company also provides exhibition design services and develops smart home health management modules. Its product portfolio includes commercial display racks, smart electric bed mechanisms, and customized design services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced metal processing technologies, strict quality control, and in-house machinery and mold calibration to meet diverse customization needs. It integrates IoT, sensors, electronic labels, and smart interactive technologies into traditional display racks to enhance functionality. Production processes include stamping, welding, polishing, electroplating, painting, assembly, and packaging, with a focus on automation to reduce labor costs and improve efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large retail chains, beverage brands, apparel industries, and pet product companies primarily in North America. The company serves major retail markets such as the United States, with expanding presence in Asia and other regions. It targets sectors requiring high-quality product display solutions and smart home furniture components.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates production facilities in Taiwan and China, with sales and engineering offices in the United States. Its main sales markets are North America (over 90% of revenue), followed by Asia and other regions. Future plans include establishing production bases in Indonesia to diversify supply chain risks and expand market reach.
categories.supply_chain_position: Horizon Fixture Group operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and assembly of metal and wood display racks and smart bed components. It sources raw materials such as steel plates, steel tubes, plywood, and electronic components from multiple suppliers to ensure stable supply. The company also provides design and engineering services, positioning itself as a comprehensive solution provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes R&D in smart technologies, including IoT-enabled display racks with intelligent irrigation functions and AI-controlled electric bed modules. It invests in product innovation to enhance added value and differentiation, focusing on automation and process upgrades to reduce costs. Strategic priorities include expanding customer base across industries, enhancing supply chain management, and diversifying markets beyond the US.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of commercial display racks and smart electric bed components. Additional income comes from exhibition design services and customized product offerings. The company also benefits from licensing and partnerships related to its smart technology developments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company faces intense competition in the commercial display rack and smart furniture markets, particularly from lower-cost manufacturers in China. It differentiates itself through high-quality, customized design, engineering expertise, and integration of smart technologies. Horizon Fixture Group maintains a stable market position by focusing on value-added services and long-term partnerships with major retail brands.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenues of approximately NT$4.01 billion, marking a 3.88% increase from the previous year and reaching a historical second-highest record. Despite some decline in operating profit and net income due to increased expenses, the company shows a stable growth trajectory with expanding production capacity and capital investments. Total assets grew by over 50% to NT$4.86 billion, supported by significant investments in property, plant, and equipment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Horizon Fixture Group offers high-quality, precision-engineered commercial display racks and smart electric bed components tailored to customer specifications. Its value proposition lies in combining advanced metal processing with smart IoT technologies to enhance product functionality and customer experience. The company emphasizes rapid sample development, reliable delivery, and sustainable materials, enabling clients to improve brand image and operational efficiency while avoiding price wars.
